verdict.rationale: New Relic docs confirm dashboard building with charts/visualizations powered by NRQL and public shareable dashboard URLs, satisfying the shareable and visualization aspects of the story. However, no evidence explicitly documents template variables (parameterized/dynamic dashboard filters), a key part of the 'dashboards-as-code' story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of template variables support, and independent/community confirmation of rich visualization variety in dashboards.
